implementation_session.disposition: bound as implementation narrative only; never substituted for a tool-attested mandatory role receipt

independent_review.resolution: Every reported Critical/High/Medium bypass was reproduced and fixed; final focused and prior suites plus live adapter replay passed after the fixes.

product_owner_manual_verification.instruction: mark manual verification complete only after gates pass

schema_omissions.fork_turns: absent from exports; adapter records omission and validators require raw/normalized agreement without assuming independence

phase2_remediation.issue: Phase 0 allowed-input control hashes bound mutable worktree bytes. Legitimate plan.md updates (task checkmarks marked in Phase 2) invalidated the frozen hash, causing independent full suite failure.
phase2_remediation.fix: Each allowed-input entry now carries an optional 'revision' field pointing to the exact Git commit whose tree is authoritative. validate_allowed_input_manifest resolves bytes through GitSourceAdapter.resolve_blob_bytes() (immutable source binding) when revision is present, instead of reading the mutable worktree. GitSourceAdapter gained resolve_blob_bytes() to support this primitive.
